answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32898 Country: India Title: On Monday morning, 6th of June, 2011, I saw a dream that I was wearing white Jubbah and Topi and standing for namaz on clouds and when I saw down, I saw the holy Kabah and the Green Tomb of our Prophet Mohammed (pbuh) in Madina together side by side. Question: My name is Irfan Ahmed and am 27 years old. Most of the time me and my elder brother spend listening to Bayans of Maulana Tariq Jameel (db), Maulana Zulfiqar Ahmed (db) and other pious Ulamas and reading Islamic books at home. My questions are as follows: On Monday morning, 6th of June, 2011, I saw a dream that I was wearing white Jubbah and Topi and standing for namaz on clouds and when I saw down, I saw the holy Kabah and the Green Tomb of our Prophet Mohammed (pbuh) in Madina together side by side. I was looking at them from the clouds in namaz and the dream ended. (2) My Elder brother Imran Ahmed, on the same day saw a dream after Fajr salah that he was standing in the Maidan-e-Mehshar and our Prophet Mohammed (pbuh) passed close to him. Please interpret these dreams. Answer ID: 32898 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1196/998/B=1432) (1) The meaning of the first dream is that in-sha-Allah you shall be honoured with the visit of holy Makkah and holy Madinah and you shall be honoured with the blessings of Hajj. (2) This dream is also nice. You shall be blessed with the closeness of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). Keep on reciting durood extensively for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
